LLM-as-a-judge paradigm is an application of LLMs as an automatic judge to assess texts . There are two types of LLM-asa-judge: (1) Direct assessment: the LLM assigns a score to a given sample . ( ) Pairwise ranking: the LLM determines which sample is better given a pair of samples .
